title: gce stage log entry v1
description: Method-neutral record of one analysis step an agent actually performed and the key quantities it produced. Typically written one JSON object per line to stage_log.jsonl.

step.description: Agent's own step counter or label.

action.description: What was done, in plain words.

params.description: Choices made: thresholds, design, test, filters.

outputs.description: Key quantities produced, keyed by a descriptive name (n_samples, n_degs, u_statistic, ...). Values may be numbers, strings, lists or objects.

artifacts.description: Files written or scripts executed for this step.

tasks.description: Tasks this step serves. 'shared' for steps common to all tasks in the run unit; omitted when the run unit has a single task.
